not_signed_in: Not signed in to Worldlines: sign in first, then publish.
insufficient_scope: This sign-in cannot upload works yet: please sign in again.
anonymous: Guest accounts cannot publish or report: sign in with a full account.
not_found: The platform has no such work (it may have been taken off).
taken_down: An admin took this work down; it cannot be published again for now — the reason is under My published works.
zone_locked: A published work does not change zone directly: use Apply for the Default Zone.
busy: The previous upload is still running; try again in a few minutes.
checks_failed: The checks did not pass, so nothing was published; fix the items below and publish again.
rate_limited: Too many publications today; try again tomorrow.
platform_error: The platform failed ({step} · {status}); try again later.
unreachable: Cannot reach the Worldlines platform; check the network and try again.
bad_id: That is not a valid work id.
too_large: This work's package is too large to download.
no_store: No writable local template store to install into (NEONRP_TEMPLATE_WRITE_DIR).
bad_package: The downloaded package could not be installed (bad format or files that are not allowed).
p_souls: Linked characters are missing from the character library: {names}
p_secret: Something that looks like a key ({kind}) is in {where}: remove it before publishing.
p_lint: The template check still has {n} blocking problem(s).
p_langs: The card (title + one-line pitch) is missing in: {langs}; add it to the card in i18n/<lang>/template.json.
p_cover: There is no cover yet (card.cover must point at an image inside the template).
published_open: Published to the Free Zone: anyone can now find it in the local Hub and download it to play.
published_review: This work is in the Default Zone: the new version is in review; the old one stays online until it passes.
unpublished: Taken off: nobody else can see it now; you can publish it again any time.
submitted: Applied for the Default Zone: the work stays in the Free Zone while it waits for review.
reported: Report received; we will look at it soon.
fetched: Downloaded to this machine; you can play it now.
export_default_zone: This is a Default Zone work (the official worlds live there too): you can play it, not export it. Only Free Zone works can be exported; if this world allows copies, “Make a copy” first, then publish your version to the Free Zone with your account.
not_forkable: This official world can be played, not copied (only templates marked as copyable can be).
official_only: This account is not an official account, so it cannot “Publish as official”. To get a work into the Default Zone, publish it to the Free Zone and apply for the Default Zone.
official_version: The version must be higher than the last published {prev}: raise template.json's version above {prev} (e.g. {next}) and publish again.
official_id_taken: “{id}” is already held by another account on the platform, so it cannot be published as official under that id — use another template id or ask an admin.
official_live: Published as an official world (revision {rev}): signed-in local players can get it from the Hub now.
official_review: Submitted as an official world (revision {rev}); it goes live once approved in the console. Until then the previous version stays up.
official_locked: This world isn't available yet: sign in to the local app with a full account (not a guest) to get Default Zone worlds.
official_updated: Updated to the latest version; runs you already started are not affected.
official_running: A run of this world is in the middle of a turn — update after the turn ends.
official_shadowed: You already have your own template with the id “{id}”; it takes precedence. Rename yours to see the official one.
submitted_curated: Submitted to the Default Zone for review: in the quick review it passes on its own if nobody raises a problem within 30 minutes; nobody else sees it before then.
withdrawn: This submission is withdrawn; an approved earlier version stays online.
blocked: Blocked: this author's works no longer show in your Discover page.
